question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **benefits**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Benefits **are advantages, positive outcomes, or rewards that result from a particular action, situation, or decision. (लाभ, सकारात्मक परिणाम या पुरस्कार हैं जो किसी विशेष कार्य, स्थिति या निर्णय के परिणामस्वरूप होते हैं)
 
• They are things that contribute positively to a person, group, or situation.
 
 
• **For example**: *The scholarship provides financial benefits to students pursuing higher education.*
 
 
 
• So, 'benefits' fit logically in the given blank and has a positive connotation.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**Bares**" is the third person singular form of the verb "**bare**," which means to uncover, reveal, or expose something that was previously hidden or covered. (किसी ऐसी चीज़ को उजागर करना, उजागर करना या उजागर करना जो पहले छिपी या ढकी हुई थी)
 
• **Pleasure **refers to a feeling of enjoyment, satisfaction, or happiness derived from a positive experience, activity, or situation. (किसी सकारात्मक अनुभव, गतिविधि या स्थिति से प्राप्त आनंद, संतुष्टि या खुशी की भावना)
 
• **Hindrances **are obstacles, barriers, or difficulties that impede progress, development, or success. (बाधाएँ या कठिनाइयाँ जो प्रगति, विकास या सफलता में बाधा डालती हैं)
